reviews.text: We’ve never built a pool before and weren’t sure what to expect but from the very first meeting until the pool was full, Pool Stop made this a great experience. Tom (inside sales) was fantastic in helping us design and layout our pool and outdoor kitchen, Stacia, Gaisy (the sales coordinators) were fantastic,  Jeremy and Victor (our project managers) we’re incredibly responsive and offered many suggestions and ideas that we incorporated that really make our backyard amazing, and Terry (pool tech) taught us everything we needed to know to take care of and maintain our pool for many years to come!!  I have and will continue to be recommending Pool Stop to anyone considering building!! Thanks for everything!!!
reviews.author: Stephen Varnell

reviews.text:
We purchased a home with a pool that was originally built by Pool Stop, so naturally, we reached out to your company when we had some questions and needed guidance. Initially, your team was very helpful, which gave us confidence in continuing to work with you.

However, that confidence quickly faded after we began discussing a quote for refinishing the pool surface and installing a chiller/heater. I first spoke with Landon, who provided an estimate for the refinishing and mentioned the chiller/heater option—something we were interested in pursuing. Landon later sent over a quote of $4,000 for the chiller/heater installation, which we agreed to move forward with via text. Unfortunately, it took nearly three days to receive a response.

When the revised quote finally arrived, the price had increased by $527, but we were still willing to proceed. I requested an itemized quote to better understand the breakdown of costs. Despite clearly explaining what I was asking for, we never received a proper itemized estimate—only a single total amount, even after multiple follow-ups.

At this point, frustration was growing. I even texted Landon asking if it’s always this difficult to do business with Pool Stop, which prompted a call and apology from him. He mentioned that Harvey, the owner, would visit the property for a site review. Harvey came by, inspected the setup, and said he would provide a final quote the next day.

Five days passed with no update. When Harvey finally did call, the final price was $5,177, nearly 25% higher than the original quote. At that point, we decided not to move forward, as the inconsistencies and lack of communication left us with serious concerns about Pool Stop’s professionalism and reliability.

As someone with decades of experience in sales, I’ve always believed in standing by a quoted price, even if a mistake was made. The way this process was handled felt disorganized, unprofessional, and misleading.

Based on this experience, I cannot recommend Pool Stop to others. I hope this feedback helps your company identify where communication and accountability can be improved for future customers.
reviews.author: Tom Church

reviews.text: GREAT POOL BUILDER!  Pool Stop just completed our pool build and we couldn’t be happier with the results.  Starting  with the design process, Kyle was patient and worked at our pace to find the right fit for our needs.  Never felt rushed or pressured into making a decision.  Once we moved into the contract phase, Victor stepped in as our Project Manager and I can’t say enough about how great he was throughout the process.  He went above and beyond, and was flexible to accommodate us throughout.  Our excavation started on June 28th and we had water in the pool on August 13th!  Our technician, Terry, has walked us through all the logistics of pool maintenance.  Everyone we’ve worked with has been extremely professional and a pleasure to work with.  We had reservations when starting this process, as I’ve heard of many challenges that can occur when building a pool.  Fortunately, our entire experience was nothing but positive…I highly recommend Pool Stop for your pool build.
reviews.author: Billy Andreason
